verdict.rationale: Veriff supports event-driven background workflows: decision and event webhooks fire automatically [veriff-docs-18, veriff-docs-41], ongoing monitoring feeds a watchlist webhook [veriff-docs-28], and a Zapier integration automates downstream workflows from verification decisions [veriff-docs-43]. However, the automation logic runs in Zapier or the customer's own webhook handlers, not in a native Veriff automation feature. Missing for 10: a native automation or rule builder, any AI or agent-driven autonomous actions, detailed docs on configuring scheduled or triggered automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
